name: Telemetry Loss
description: A normal day. The Membrane link to the 140 MW site drops while it draws 140 MW. The on-site controller falls back to 90 MW firm within its ramp cap while the grid keeps serving the site.

beats.title: Normal operations
beats.text: The site draws 140 MW: 90 firm and 50 flexible on grid headroom.

beats.title: Membrane link lost
beats.text: Controller detects the loss and ramps to the 90 MW firm limit. Grid service is uninterrupted.

beats.title: Link restored
beats.text: Buffered ledger entries backfill and the hash chain still verifies. The site ramps back up within its caps.
